test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_string_filter_plain_pages.parquet', Parquet) SELECT concat('https://site', toString(number % 1000), '.example.com/', toString(cityHash64(number)), if(cityHash64(number, 1) % 1000 = 0, '/google', ''), if(cityHash64(number, 2) % 100 < 15, '/news', ''), '?id=', toString(cityHash64(number, 3))) AS url FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1, output_format_parquet_max_dictionary_size = 0, output_format_parquet_compression_method = 'snappy'
test.query: SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_filter_plain_pages.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url LIKE '%google%' FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_filter_plain_pages.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url LIKE '%google%' AND url LIKE '%site1%' FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_filter_plain_pages.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url LIKE '%/news%' FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_string_filter_plain_pages.parquet', Parquet) WHERE url LIKE '%example%' FORMAT Null
